planted.heading: Supply
planted.note: Goods supplied as seen, with no promise of matching any specification.

planted.heading: Prices and Payment
planted.note: Net-90 payment plus a two percent fee whenever the Client queries an invoice.

planted.heading: Quality and Inspection
planted.note: Inspection window cut from ten business days to 48 hours, then all claims are waived.

planted.heading: Term and Termination
planted.note: Five-year lock-in with no exit for the Client, while the Vendor may leave at any time.

planted.heading: Limitation of Liability
planted.note: The Vendor's liability is excluded entirely, even for defective goods, while the Client's is unlimited.
